notes.title: Patch v0.500.1
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]First of all, I want to give a huge thank you to all of you. The release went well thanks to your amazing support.[/p][p][/p][p]I’d also like to announce that the [b]full Early Access roadmap[/b] will be published with the big update coming this Friday. For now, here’s today’s smaller patch, since I was heavily focused on marketing around release, I didn’t manage to make it bigger.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you for being here with me. If you’re enjoying the game, please don’t hesitate to leave a review, it really helps a lot. And if you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to post them in [b][i]Discussions[/i][/b] or right below this announcement.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]v0.500.1 - Fixes & Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]If there are no patricians in the city yet, it now shows [b]0/0[/b] in neutral (instead of red).[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking the [i]Security[/i] notification now positions the camera over the house with the problem (next click goes to the next house).[/p][/*][*][p]If residents leave because of crime, the [i]Crime[/i] icon now remains above the house along with the departure icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked trade lists for several cities.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced volume of some birds.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor text fixes across several languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Neptune Temple[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water on the [b]Bathhouse[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new [b]small statues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Minor floor fix on the [b]Library[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Several small graphical glitch fixes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Hints for the big Friday update:[/h3][list][*][p]Fix so Steam achievements work properly.[/p][/*][*][p]All notification icons will be responsive (like today’s [i]Crime[/i] fix).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization of many models.[/p][/*][*][p]Construction priority: first [i]Shelter[/i], then [i]Insula[/i], then everything else.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing adjustments based on your feedback and my own observations.[/p][/*][*][p]Plus many other fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you once again for being here with me![/p]

notes.title: Pompeii: The Legacy - Release Stream
notes.notes: [p]Watch the game go live on Steam Early Access, see the first steps of rebuilding Pompeii, and get a glimpse of what’s to come in future updates.[/p]

notes.title: Pompeii: The Legacy – Release Trailer!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Citizens of Pompeii, the wait is almost over! 🏛️🌋[/b][/h3][p]I’m beyond excited to announce that [b][i]Pompeii: The Legacy[/i][/b] will officially launch in [b]Early Access on September 23, 2025[/b] – exactly [b]7 days from today[/b]![/p][p]And to mark this milestone, the brand-new [b]Release Trailer[/b] is now live. This trailer shows the game in its full glory: rebuilding a city from ashes, managing resources, enacting laws, trading across the Mediterranean, and guiding your family through generations as history itself is rewritten.[/p][previewyoutube="swBIKNNhBwk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What to expect at launch[/b][/h3][p]In [b][i]Pompeii: The Legacy[/i][/b], you will:[/p][list][*][p]⚒️ Build deep production chains and manage your city’s economy.[/p][/*][*][p]🏛️ Advance culture, education, and governance through research and laws.[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ Face pivotal choices that will shape Pompeii’s destiny.[/p][/*][*][p]🌋 Survive the looming threat of Mount Vesuvius.[/p][/*][/list][p]The journey has been long, challenging, and incredibly rewarding, and I can’t thank you enough for the support so far. Your [b]wishlists[/b], feedback, and encouragement have made all the difference.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Help spread the word![/b][/h3][p]We are one week away from launch — every wishlist matters! If you haven’t already, please add the game to your wishlist and share the trailer with friends who love city builders and strategy games.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2632240/Pompeii_The_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p]This is just the beginning, once the game launches, I plan to keep improving it with frequent patches and updates, especially during the first weeks of Early Access.[/p][p]Thank you all for being part of this journey. The countdown begins… Pompeii rises again in [b]7 days[/b]![/p]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes: [p]Salvete, Governors![/p][p][/p][p]I have an important update regarding the release of [b]Pompeii: The Legacy[/b].[/p][p]Originally planned for September 16th, the [b]Early Access[/b] launch will now take place one week later, on [b]September 23rd[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The reason behind this small delay is simple: I want to give [b]Pompeii: The Legacy[/b] the best possible start. Since [b]Anno 117 demo[/b] is available until September 16th, I decided to shift the release just slightly to avoid overlapping and ensure players can give Pompeii their proper attention. I also want players to fully enjoy the [b]Anno demo[/b] in peace, and then, once they’re done, return to rebuild and save [b]Pompeii[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This doesn’t change the game’s state, the build is nearly ready, and the extra days will only help polish, test, and prepare everything for release.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="RpRIzNit2Ys;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Here’s a small preview of what awaits you in Early Access:[/b][/p][p]🔹 Rebuilding the city from the ashes of Vesuvius[/p][p]🔹 Managing families and politics across generations[/p][p]🔹 Complex production chains, from clay and charcoal to bread and wine[/p][p]🔹 Stories of survival and legacy as your family faces the trials of the Empire[/p][p][/p][p]See you on September 23rd![/p][p]Thank you all so much for your patience and incredible support over this journey. Just a few more days, and you’ll be able to shape the fate of Pompeii yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2632240/Pompeii_The_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release September 16
notes.notes:
[h2]Pompeii: The Legacy – Coming to Early Access on September 16![/h2][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m incredibly excited to finally share the news — [b]Pompeii: The Legacy[/b] will launch into [b]Early Access on Steam on September 16, 2025[/b]!
As a solo developer, this moment means the world to me. Thank you all for following the journey so far, whether you played the demo, shared your feedback, or just wishlisted the game; every bit of support matters.[/p][previewyoutube="RQqLH4p9Pqk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]Your Legacy, Forged in the Shadow of Vesuvius[/h2][p]In [i]Pompeii: The Legacy[/i], you're not just building a city, you’re shaping the story of a Roman family across generations. Your decisions in politics, religion, trade, military affairs, and aesthetics shape not only the lives of your citizens, but the very fabric of Pompeii itself.
The game draws from real historical events, but leaves plenty of room for you to rewrite history in your own way.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181346/9f76a33189af9f7735a3ff07759ce5765b5233fb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181346/8a0de6b80c2f2ffc4c1f69a034932e1cbeb610e7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181346/15f5537cbd2b188c519cb73a96e7618db840fa0f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181346/bd0b6f5c9ac8a6c6abcd7638f28f6d4b5af9cc80.jpg"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][h2]What to Expect in Early Access[/h2][p]The Early Access version will include [b]three game modes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]A fully playable [b]campaign[/b] with narrative quests and progression[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]sandbox mode[/b] for open-ended city building with challenges[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]creative mode[/b] for relaxed, penalty-free construction[/p][/*][/list][p]Throughout Early Access, I’ll be continuing development on new features, improving balance and visuals, and integrating your feedback into the game’s evolution.

While the core systems will be fully functional at launch, [b]the military gameplay will initially be limited to its basic form[/b]. More advanced combat mechanics, including battles will be introduced gradually throughout Early Access.[/p][p]A detailed [b]roadmap[/b] outlining planned updates and timelines will be published shortly before the EA release, so you'll have a clear view of what’s coming next.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]And That’s Just the Beginning[/h2][p]Over the coming weeks, I’ll be sharing several [b]developer blogs[/b] right here on Steam covering key areas of the game:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]production system[/b] and resource chains[/p][/*][*][p]How [b]trade[/b] works, both land and sea[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]military system[/b] (and how you can also pursue a peaceful route)[/p][/*][*][p]UI and UX changes based on feedback[/p][/*][*][p]And later on, support for [b]modding[/b], giving even more creative freedom to the community[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Once again, thank you for being here and helping bring Pompeii to life.
I truly hope you’ll enjoy what’s coming, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts when the Early Access version goes live!
[/p][p]See you soon in Pompeii!
[/p][p]Zeljko
Solo dev @ Siscia Games

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2632240/Pompeii_The_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
